children: Onfolio Holdings entered into a Limited Forbearance Agreement and Reaffirmation of Loan Documents related to an $850,000 promissory note tied to its Eastern Standard acquisition. The deal requires a $450,000 initial payment by Oct. 31, 2026, followed by $60,000 monthly installments starting Dec. 1, 2026 and a final $45,754.29 payment on Jul. 1, 2027, totaling $915,754.29 including interest and fees. While Onfolio complies with the schedule, the lender will forbear from exercising remedies; default interest continues to accrue and the note's maturity is unchanged. Upon timely completion, the note will be deemed paid and related security interests and guaranty released.
